title: Implement cook mode step-by-step navigator
description: Replace the CookPhase.steps placeholder in CookModeView with a real step-by-step navigator: one step per screen, forward/back navigation, per-step ingredient sidebar, and a finish affordance that dismisses cook mode.
acceptance_criteria: Navigating to .steps from gather phase shows step 1 of the recipe.
User can advance forward through steps and go back, with progress indicated.
Per-step ingredient list (read-only) is shown alongside each step text.
Finishing the last step returns to the recipe detail sheet (dismisses fullScreenCover).

handoff_summary.completed: Step navigator implemented: StepsPhase in CookModeStepView.swift with forward/back navigation, progress indicator, per-step read-only CookModeIngredientList, and CookModeDonePage that calls dismiss(). CookModeView.swift correctly routes to StepsPhase from the gather phase.
handoff_summary.remaining: None — all four acceptance criteria verified against existing code.
handoff_summary.risks: None identified. Implementation is complete and self-contained within the CookMode file group.
handoff_summary.next_action: Hand off to tester agent for validation of the full cook mode flow end-to-end.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: None — no files were modified by this bead.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Implementation was already present via B-a606fa82. StepsPhase uses TabView with .page style and manual prev/next buttons rather than swipe-only to ensure discoverable navigation on screen readers and small devices.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: CookModeViewTests.swift already covers view instantiation, step counting, done-page index, and navigation boundary conditions. No new test gaps introduced.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: The "Next" button on the last step advances to the done page but does not disable itself — the done page simply hides the nav bar. Acceptable for current scope.

conflict_risks: None — no files were modified by this bead.

execution_history.summary: All acceptance criteria for the step-by-step navigator are already satisfied by code merged in sibling bead B-a606fa82. CookModeStepView.swift provides StepsPhase (TabView pager, prev/next buttons, progress counter, per-step read-only ingredient list) and CookModeDonePage (dismiss() button). CookModeView.swift wires the gather phase to StepsPhase via `phase = .steps`. No code changes were required.
